onboarding.readBody: Every row and column has a header: a club or a country.
onboarding.answerBody: Pick a cell and type a footballer who fits both of its headers. You have {{seconds}} seconds.
onboarding.winBody: Three cells in a line win the game. If nobody manages it, the side with more cells wins.

welcome.guestHint: Your guest account stays on this phone.

register.title: Create account
register.usernameHint: Your username cannot be changed later.

home.subtitle: Name a footballer who fits both the row and the column.
home.modeLocalHint: Share one phone and take turns.
home.modeFriendHint: Open a private room with a code.
home.subtitleDuel: Pick seven cards. Each round, the better card for the question scores.
home.subtitleDraft: Each round reveals a club. Add a footballer who played there to your lineup; the lineup with more career assists wins.
home.subtitleHigher: Two footballers, one question: whose goals, assists, value or age come out on top? Keep answering right to keep your turn.
home.subtitleChain: Take turns naming someone who played at the same club as the last footballer. Miss or get it wrong and you lose the round; three rounds win.

account.title: Account
account.offlineHint: The server could not be reached. Offline play still works.
account.guestNote: To create an account or sign in, sign out first. Your guest account stays on this phone and opens again when you continue as guest.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
errors.unconfigured: Online play is not set up in this build.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.alreadySignedIn: Sign out before signing in to another account.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is wrong.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidUsername: Usernames are 3 to 16 letters, digits or underscores.
errors.invalidPassword: The password does not meet the rules below.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not available yet.
errors.invalidIdentityToken: Sign-in could not be verified. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

online.searchingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
online.roomHint: Your friend enters this code to join.
online.failureOffline: The server could not be reached.
online.failureSignedOut: Online play needs a connection to your account. Try again when you are online.
online.failureOutdated: Update the app to play online.
online.failureReplaced: You are playing on another device.
online.failureRoomNotFound: There is no room with this code.
online.failureGeneric: Online play is not available right now.

friend.title: Play a friend
friend.createHint: You get a code to share with your friend.

credits.title: Image sources
credits.intro: Player portraits are illustrations made from freely licensed photographs on Wikimedia Commons. Each illustration is shared under the same licence as its source photograph.
credits.empty: There are no portraits in this version yet.

duel.pickHint: You pick before you know the questions: goals, assists, matches, age… anything can come up.
duel.questionMarketValue: The higher peak market value wins

draft.searchEmpty: No footballer fits your open slots. Only players with assist data are listed.

higher.questionMarketValue: Whose peak market value was higher?

chain.rule: Name someone who played at the same club as the last footballer
chain.scope: The shared club must be in the Süper Lig or one of Europe's big five leagues. A name cannot be said twice in a round.
